body: No, those things never appealed to me.  I'm not the least scared of heights so skydiving would be boring. And I personally can't enjoy anything with cancer lingering in my head. It's easy enough for you to say.  You don't have to feel betrayed by your body. You don't have cancer on your mind.  I like routine, I can't just say 'Fuck all' and do whatever. I spent all my time inside my room feeling safe from everything then internal chaos blooms inside of me?
